CREATE TABLE world_deletion_requests (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	world_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	owner_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	idempotency_key VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	confirmation_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	stage VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	cursor INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lease_until DATETIME, 
	failures INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	next_attempt_at DATETIME, 
	failure_code VARCHAR(64), 
	accepted_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	completed_at DATETIME, 
	updated_at DATETIME DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(owner_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	UNIQUE (owner_id, idempotency_key), 
	UNIQUE (world_id)
)
indexes: CREATE INDEX ix_world_deletion_work ON world_deletion_requests (state, next_attempt_at)

CREATE TABLE world_deletion_cleanup_items (
	id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	item_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reference JSON NOT NULL, 
	state VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(request_id) REFERENCES world_deletion_requests (id), 
	UNIQUE (request_id, kind, item_key)
)
